en: A black and white photograph depicting a traditional Scandinavian fishing village by the water. Wooden boathouses stand on stilts at the water's edge, with several small fishing boats moored nearby. Behind the waterfront buildings, more traditional houses and a hilly landscape are visible. The word 'HUNNEBOSTRAND' is printed in clear white text in the lower left corner. There is a small emblem and the number '5418' in the bottom right.
